description: Clone of exp006 (single-head HyperplaneMHL FFN replacing the dense MLP) with ONLY the LUT geometry changed: n_anchor_pairs 5->6 (K=2^6=64 rows) and tables_per_head 128->256. Everything else identical to exp006/the locked config (n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, hard forward, random init +0.001 noise, LUT bf16 / hyperplanes fp32, hybrid Lion+Adam-no-wd optimizer routed by parameter identity, grad_clip 1.0, 16000 steps, eval_every 200, seed 1). Bigger LUT -> ~2x exp001 params (~70M). Compares vs exp001 anchor 1.20144 and vs exp006's 1.2645.
